page.layout: One printed page: digitiser's cover sheet. Top right: library logo (SUB Göttingen), omitted. Then a bibliographic block "Werk", then "Terms and Conditions" with a paragraph, then "Contact" with an address block. No printed text of the early modern book is present.
page.notes: This is the digitiser's cover sheet of the Göttingen State and University Library (VD17 digitisation), not a page of the 1655 book. The logo at the top is omitted. The bibliographic data and the terms/contact information are reproduced below as printed on the sheet, since the instructions for empty pages allow only stains, stamps and digitiser's cover sheets to be left out; the cover text is therefore given here for completeness.
